# A group page lists its component entries as tiles

## Context

Design 4 and 5 of #21140: "A *component* entry is one component in the workbench, and gets a compact tile … The record says which (`kind: 'component'`; a demonstration is the default)." A group page has "one header per kind when it holds both", with six tiles per row at 1440 × 900 (design 6). The Portal half stacks on the shell's pull request, #21325. Lane epic #21329.

## The Problem

A group page renders every record as a cover card. A workbench entry therefore reads as an empty page: Forms & Fields shows three white cards titled by class name.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Portal.model.Example#publishes()` is the one rule for a card: a cover, and a URL in the selected build.
- `GroupPage` renders the group's records through `List`.
- `MainContainerController#publishGroups()` (`apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.mjs:96`) writes `count` and `crossCount` on each group on every load and build switch.
- #21325 keeps `tileHeading: 'Field types'` on the `forms` family definition.
- Design authority: #21140's body, design 4: "A tile needs no hand-made cover: one recipe captures every workbench stage's component by its own rectangle", and its build note: "A record becomes `kind: 'component'` in the pull request that gives it its crop, never before: a tile without an image would unpublish its group."

## The Fix

- `kind` on `Portal.model.Example`, defaulting to a demonstration.
- A tile list on the group page under the group's `tileHeading` (default "Components"); the headers show only when a group holds both kinds.
- Per-kind counts written by `publishGroups()`.
- A record for every workbench entry with `kind: 'component'` and its crop from the tile recipe as `image`.
- The Forms & Fields records #21140 marks ✕ leave the catalog: `form/field/picker`, `date/selectorContainer`, and `fields` once #21334's Range entry is on `dev`. Their folders stay (#21140: "the folder stays where a spec loads it").

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A record with `kind: 'component'` renders as a tile showing its crop and its name; a demonstration still renders as a card.
- [ ] AC-2: A group holding both kinds shows "Demonstrations", then its tile heading; a group holding one kind shows no header.
- [ ] AC-3: A tile publishes under the same rule as a card, so it needs an image and a URL in the selected build. A group made only of tiles publishes once one tile passes.
- [ ] AC-4: The per-kind counts follow a build switch.
- [ ] AC-5: Six tiles per row at 1440 × 900, with frames of the Forms & Fields page at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844 on the pull request.
- [ ] AC-6: Unit specs pin `kind`, the publish rule for tiles and the counts.
- [ ] AC-7: `examples.json` holds no record for `form/field/picker`, `date/selectorContainer` or `fields`.

## Out of Scope

- The capture recipe (its own leaf under #21329).
- The shell, Start here and Find (#21325, #21326).

## Intake on `dev` `a4f333a2cc` (Ada, 18 Nov)

The shell is on `dev` (PR #21347), and nothing in it changes the fix above. This exploration settled three things:

- **Counts.** A tile opens a live workbench entry, so it is a live example too. `count` and `crossCount` keep counting every published record of either kind, so the overview headline and the index count both kinds. `publishGroups()` adds `tileCount`, the tiles a page shows (its own and those other groups lend it). The two headers show only when the page has tiles and cards. A group made only of tiles publishes through the same counts (AC-3).
- **Census.** `example-captures.json` lists 45 tile paths. 27 of them already have a record, which turns `kind: 'component'` and takes `devmode/tiles/<tile id>-14.jpg`. 18 have none and get one: `form/field/` country, currency, display, iban, password, phone, range, search and zipcode; `button/base`, `menu/list`, `list/base`, `list/chip`, `list/color`; `functional/` defineComponent, hostComponent and nestedTemplateComponent; and `sitemap`. The records that leave (AC-7) are `picker-field`, `fields-runtime-triggers` and `date-selector-container`.
- **Renderer.** `List` gets a tile mode: the crop on a fixed 4:3 surface in the stage's dark colour, in both Portal themes (the crops are dark-theme stages), with the name below. It uses the same link and the same lazy image path as a card. The range tile is on neomjs/pages#117, so this PR merges after it.

**Progress, by the builder (Ada)**

`ada/21333-component-tiles` is on `dev` `a4f333a2cc` with two commits, pushed. No PR yet.

- `9caf21bda6`: `Portal.model.Example#kind` (default `'demonstration'`, else `'component'`). `ExampleGroup#tileCount` holds the tiles a page shows, its own and lent ones, and `publishGroups()` writes it. A tile counts as a live example, as the intake section above decides.
- `fda706dd93`: `GroupPage` renders two lists over its records: the cards (`getList()`) and the tiles (`getTileList()`, `List#tiles`: the crop over the name). "Demonstrations" and the group's `tileHeading` (default "Components") head them only when the page shows both. `MainContainer#afterSetCatalogMode` filters both lists through `GroupPage#getLists()`.
- The unit arm "a component record is a tile: it counts as a live example, and its page's tileCount follows the build" covers AC-1, AC-2 and AC-4 on a forms record made a tile. Portal units pass 122 of 122.

**Still open, in order:**
1. The tile CSS in `List.css`: a grid (six per row at 1440 × 900, AC-5) and a fixed 4:3 image box that shows the crop on the stage's dark colour in both Portal themes. Check that colour against the crops.
2. The records (census in the body). The 27 existing records become `kind: 'component'` with `devmode/tiles/<tile>-14.jpg`. That replaces the old covers of `combobox-field`, `date-field` and `date-selector`. 18 new records follow, and `picker-field`, `fields-runtime-triggers` and `date-selector-container` leave (AC-7). Many names are class names (`form.field.Text`); a tile shows its name, so give them readable ones.
3. The catalog unit and Portal e2e pins: counts, order, groups that publish now (Buttons, Functional and Layouts become tile-only groups).
4. Frames of the Forms & Fields page at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, and the PR. The range tile is on neomjs/pages#117, so the PR merges after it.
